title: Network Participation Agreements: Agreements under Notice and the Continuing Capitation Withholding Share
content:
**Rule.** A continuing capitation withholding is booked against a capitation payment of a Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement under the **Network Participation Agreements**. When that agreement is ending under notice, the exit acceleration of the withholding share is set by the agreement's status and its termination date:

- an agreement in termination pending status whose termination date is 90 days or fewer after today adds 25 share points;
- an agreement in termination pending status whose termination date is more than 90 days after today adds 10 share points;
- an agreement that is not in termination pending status adds nothing.

## Terms

- **Status.** The status is read from the agreement record. "Termination pending" is the status an agreement holds between a notice of termination without cause and its termination date.
- **Days to the termination date.** These are calendar days from today to the termination date. Today is not counted; the termination date is.

## Decision table

| Agreement status | Days from today to the termination date | Share points added |
|---|---|---|
| Termination pending | 90 or fewer | 25 |
| Termination pending | 91 or more | 10 |
| Active, or any status other than termination pending | — | None |

## Hypothetical cases

- An agreement in termination pending status has a termination date 90 days away. It is in the near band and adds 25 points. The same agreement viewed one day earlier, with 91 days to go, adds 10 points.
- An active agreement with no notice on file adds nothing, whatever its history.
